Title: This week only
Prompt: Write three captions for the offer I paste. Include the date and the price I gave you. Do not add a discount.
Check: Price and date match my paste.

Title: Sold out
Prompt: Write a caption that says it is sold out and names when it returns only if I told you. Do not tease a restock.

Title: Hours
Prompt: Write one caption with the new hours and the old hours so people are not surprised. Use only the hours I paste.
Check: Both sets of hours are mine.

Title: Behind the counter
Prompt: Write a caption about the step I describe. Do not claim a certification or an award.

Title: Quiet day
Use when: You need a post and nothing is on sale.
Prompt: Write a caption that tells people what is available today. Do not invent urgency.

Title: Reply to a comment
Use when: A customer asked a question in public.
Prompt: Draft a reply that answers only what I know. If I do not know, the reply says we will check.
